items.title: How to Calculate Credit Card Interest
items.content: Credit card interest is calculated daily using your APR...
items.excerpt: A simple guide to how credit card interest is calculated.
items.seo_title: Credit Card Interest Calculator Guide | CalcMyCard
items.meta_description: Learn how credit card interest is calculated from APR and daily balance, with examples.

faq.question: How is credit card interest calculated?
faq.answer: Divide your APR by 365 and multiply by your average daily balance.

faq.question: Can I avoid interest?
faq.answer: Yes, pay the full statement balance by the due date.
